<div style='text-align: justify;'>
# Wave 2

## Sample

Data from Wave 2 in this dashboard is based on the completed questionnaires of **1,597 participants**, of which 1,387 via an online panel and 210 via an address sample (online via letter and paper-and-pencil questionnaire). Data collection took place in **June 2025**.
</div>
